settings.grant.refused_hint: Ask an administrator with a wider scope, or choose a narrower scope or profile.

settings.markets.caption: Markets
settings.markets.code_fixed: The code cannot change: contracts and bookings refer to it.
settings.markets.code_hint: 2–20 capital letters, digits or _. Fixed once saved.
settings.markets.countries_hint: ISO country codes, separated by commas (e.g. DE, AT, CH). A guest's country picks the market with the shortest list containing it.
settings.markets.disable_hint: A disabled market sells nothing new; existing bookings keep it.
settings.markets.is_global_hint: Applies to guests from countries no other market lists. It lists no countries itself.
settings.markets.residents_only_hint: Web bookings need a country of residence or a nationality among the market's countries. Call Center agents may book anyway with a reason, kept in the audit log.
settings.markets.name: Name
settings.markets.overlap_body: Guests from these countries get no market automatically; staff and the booking engine must choose one.
settings.markets.overlap_title: Some countries belong to two equally specific markets
settings.markets.parent_hint: For grouping in reports (e.g. DE under DACH). It does not change prices.
settings.markets.read_only: Markets are shared by all hotels; only platform administrators can change them.
settings.markets.saved_overlap: Saved. Countries shared with an equally specific market:
settings.markets.subtitle: Source markets every contract, markup, promotion and payment rule refers to.
settings.profiles.channels_any_note: “Price and book on every sales channel” is selected: holders sell on every channel, whatever is ticked here.
settings.profiles.channels_default_note: No channel ticked: holders sell on the call center only.
settings.profiles.channels_edit_hint: Channels holders may price and book on. None ticked: the call center only.
settings.profiles.channels_hint: Where holders price and book. The server refuses every other channel.
settings.profiles.matrix_caption: Capabilities by permission profile, grouped by area
settings.profiles.matrix_hint: What each profile allows. A grant gives a user one profile at a hotel, hotel group or enterprise.
settings.profiles.name: Profile name
settings.profiles.read_only: Only platform administrators can change permission profiles. You can see what each profile allows.
settings.profiles.saved: Profile saved. Users holding it get the new capabilities right away.
settings.profiles.sensitive_legend: Sensitive: exposes costs, moves money, exports personal data or changes who has access.

settings.profiles.system_warning: This is a system profile. Changes apply at once to every user who holds it.
settings.scope.enterprise_hint: Every hotel of every group in the enterprise.
settings.scope.hotel_group_hint: Every hotel in the group, including hotels added later.
settings.scope.platform_hint: Everything on this TEX Engine installation.
settings.status.alerts_hint: Every 15 minutes TEX e-mails the alert recipients when a check gets worse or recovers.
settings.status.check.payments.overpaid: Bookings paid more than they cost
settings.status.ping_hint: Point an uptime monitor at this address. It answers HTTP 200 with "ok":true, or HTTP 503, and reveals nothing else.
settings.status.reason.callback_errors: Payment callbacks failed or rejected in the last {hours} h: {count}.
settings.status.reason.capture_mismatch: Gateway captures that did not match their charge in the last {days} days: {count}.
settings.status.reason.check_error: This check could not run (see the Error Log).
settings.status.reason.contract_not_sell: Active contracts within their sale window with no version on sale and none starting within {days} days: {count}. They sell nothing.
settings.status.reason.contract_starts_s: Active contracts within their sale window with no version on sale; one starts within {days} days: {count}.
settings.status.reason.contract_ends_soo: Contracts that stop selling within {days} days (their version on sale ends and no version starts then): {count}.
settings.status.reason.fx_missing: No {provider} rate for {pair}: prices that need it cannot be computed.
settings.status.reason.fx_old: {provider} {pair}: the latest rate is {days} days old.
settings.status.reason.fx_bridged: {provider} {pair}: the provider's rate is stale or missing; prices use a manual rate dated {manual_days} days ago, with each policy's margin on it.
settings.status.reason.fx_stale: {provider} {pair}: the latest rate is {days} days old, over the policy's limit of {max_days}: prices that need it cannot be computed.
settings.status.reason.job_errors: TEX job errors in the last {hours} h: {count} (see the Error Log).
settings.status.reason.job_missing: Job {job} is not registered (run bench migrate).
settings.status.reason.key_missing: No encryption_key in site_config: offers, payment callbacks and webhooks cannot be signed.
settings.status.reason.snapshot_isolatio: MariaDB innodb_snapshot_isolation is ON ({level}): a booking that waited for the last room fails with an error instead of being told it sold out. Set innodb_snapshot_isolation = 0 in the database server's configuration.
settings.status.reason.mail_failed: E-mails failed in the last {hours} h: {count}.
settings.status.reason.mail_suspended: Sending e-mail is suspended on this site.
settings.status.reason.mail_unsent: E-mails not sent yet: {count}, oldest waiting {minutes} min.
settings.status.reason.maintenance_mode: The site is in maintenance mode: no TEX job runs.
settings.status.reason.no_outgoing_accou: No default outgoing e-mail account: guest e-mails cannot be sent.
settings.status.reason.overpaid: Payment links paid twice in the last {days} days: {count}.
settings.status.reason.payment_pending: Card payments still pending: {count}, oldest started {minutes} min ago.
settings.status.reason.payment_pending_u: Card payments of a gateway TEX cannot ask, still pending after their deadline: {count}, oldest started {minutes} min ago. Check them in the bank's panel; if one was charged, record it as a Manual payment with the bank's reference. The alert clears 48 hours after the payment.
settings.status.reason.reconciliation_ac: Payments kept off their booking, waiting for staff: {count}, oldest waiting {hours} h (Payments → the payment).
settings.status.reason.reconciliation_re: Payments queued for an automatic refund: {count}, oldest waiting {hours} h.
settings.status.reason.bookings_overpaid: Bookings holding more money than they cost: {count} ({cancelled} of them cancelled). Refund the excess or move it to the booking it was meant for (Payments). A refund still on its way counts as paid until the gateway answers it.
settings.status.reason.hold_overdue: Bookings still holding rooms after their hold ended: {count}, the oldest ended {minutes} min ago. Their expiry keeps failing (see the Error Log).
settings.status.reason.redis_unreachable: The background job queue (Redis) cannot be reached.
settings.status.reason.refund_unknown: Refunds the gateway never confirmed: {count}. Check them at the gateway before refunding again.
settings.status.reason.refund_conflict: Refunds the gateway answered differently from the outcome recorded for them: {count}. Check them at the gateway and record what it actually did.
settings.status.reason.scheduler_disable: The scheduler is disabled: no TEX job runs.
settings.status.reason.scheduler_paused: The scheduler is paused: no TEX job runs.
settings.status.subtitle: Background jobs, queues, payments, FX rates and e-mail, checked when you open this page.

settings.tex.strict_off_title: Strict tenancy is off — hotel data is not isolated
